description: Build the complete NecroText app: teletext core, page generators, browser UI, haunted layer, data fetch script with offline fallback, tests. Single coherent unit (greenfield).
steps: git: stay on branch necrotext-build. Add LICENSE (MIT, 2026), .gitignore (must NOT ignore .kiro; ignore dist/, node_modules/), package.json (type=module, scripts: build, test, start, fetch-data, lint using node --check).

Kiro artifacts first (spec-driven): .kiro/specs/necrotext-core/{requirements.md (EARS format, numbered), design.md, tasks.md with checkboxes ticked as done}; .kiro/specs/haunted-layer/ and .kiro/specs/live-data-pages/ likewise (short but real). .kiro/steering/{product.md, teletext-constraints.md (40x24, control codes, palette, no em dashes), retro-design-language.md, testing.md, tech.md} with front matter inclusion mode (always / fileMatch on src/**). .kiro/hooks/*.kiro.hook JSON files: run tests on save of src/**/*.js, lint/regenerate pages on data/*.json change, and a pre-commit style grid-check hook. Optional .kiro/settings/mcp.json with a filesystem or fetch MCP entry only if sensible, disabled by default.

src/teletext/: constants.js (COLS=40, ROWS=24, palette of 8 colours, control code table 0x00-0x1F per World System Teletext level 1), grid.js (Page/Grid class, set/get cells, serial attributes), mosaic.js (2x3 sixel mosaic chars, contiguous vs separated, helper to draw boxes, big bars, sparkline charts), text.js (word wrap to width, truncation, centring, uppercase conversion, accent folding to ASCII, double-height row helper that blanks the next row), layout.js (header row 0 with page number, title and clock; footer row 23 with colour-key labels via fastext red/green/yellow/cyan), render.js (grid to DOM-free cell model; resolves serial attributes into per-cell fg/bg/mosaic/double-height/flash/conceal state).

src/pages/: registry.js (page number to generator, sub-pages like 101/1 with auto-cycling, fastext links per page), index.js (100 home with the index of sections), news.js (101-1xx from RSS: headline index and story pages, word-wrapped, multiple subpages), weather.js (400s from Open-Meteo JSON with mosaic icons and temperature sparkline), tech/sport/finance style pages from feeds (e.g. Hacker News API, BBC sport RSS), tv.js (fake TV listings, 600s), games.js (a quiz and a haunted mansion text adventure, 700s), about.js (800 how Kiro built this, 899 help with key list), 404 page 'PAGE NOT FOUND' teletext style.

Haunted layer (must enhance function): page 666 'THE DEAD LETTER OFFICE' lists stories/feeds that failed or were stale (real dead-link/stale-data report from data fetch status, so it is useful diagnostics), page 667 'ORACLE' fortune built from today's headlines, page 13 'UNLUCKY' easter egg. src/ghost.js: ghost subtitles page 888 and random 'ghost' overlay on row 22 that spells out spooky messages derived from page content, rare glitch corruption of a few cells, and a CRT 'seance' mode toggled with key S that raises flicker, red tint and corrupts text. Everything seeded and deterministic in tests (inject a PRNG).

public/: index.html, style.css, app.js, crt.js. Render grid to a <canvas> or CSS grid using a bundled teletext font approach WITHOUT external font downloads: draw glyphs with a monospace system font fallback plus mosaic blocks drawn as rects on canvas for exact look; double-height via canvas scaling. CRT effect via CSS/canvas (scanlines, vignette, slight curvature, flicker, phosphor bloom), toggle with C. Keyboard: digits type 3-digit page number with header showing P1xx progressive entry like a real TV (shows P--- then digits, 'searching' roll of page numbers while loading), R/G/Y/B keys or F1-F4 or on-screen colour buttons for fastext, Up/Down or +/- next/prev page, Left/Right subpage, 0 then Enter index, H for help overlay, M for mute/sound (small WebAudio beeps optional), reveal key X toggles conceal, Esc. On-screen remote control for mobile. URL hash routing (#/100, #/101/2) so pages are shareable. Mobile responsive, aspect 4:3 scaling, respects prefers-reduced-motion (disable flicker).

Data: scripts/fetch-data.js fetches feeds (BBC News RSS https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml, BBC tech/sport/world, Open-Meteo forecast API for a few cities, Hacker News Firebase API topstories) with timeouts, tiny regex/XML parser written in src/data/rss.js (no deps), writes data/*.json plus data/status.json (per-source ok/stale/error with timestamps used by page 666). Commit hand-authored realistic fallback snapshots in data/ because the sandbox cannot reach the network. App loads data/*.json at runtime (fetch relative), falls back to embedded snapshot; show 'CACHED' marker in header when stale. Add .github/workflows/pages.yml: cron every 30 minutes runs fetch-data, build, deploys dist/ to GitHub Pages; and .github/workflows/test.yml running npm test.
scripts/build.js copies public/ + src/ + data/ into dist/ (with relative import paths that work under a Pages subpath); scripts/serve.js minimal static server for local use (port 8080).

Tests (tests/): unit tests for text wrap/truncate, mosaic encode, serial attribute resolution, rss parser (use fixture XML), fastext link validity. PROPERTY-BASED tests using tests/helpers/prop.js (seeded mulberry32 PRNG, forAll(gen, prop, runs=200), shrinking-light): (1) for every registered page and subpage across random data and random seeds, the grid is exactly 24 rows x 40 columns; (2) every cell code is in the allowed set (0x20-0x7F printable plus defined control codes 0x00-0x1F), no em dashes or non-ASCII; (3) row 0 always contains the page number; (4) wrap(text,w) never exceeds w and preserves non-space characters; (5) double-height rows are followed by a blank row; (6) every fastext target resolves to an existing page; (7) ghost corruption never changes dimensions and is deterministic for a seed. A test that every page in the registry renders with the committed fallback data.

README.md: pitch, screenshot placeholder (or generated ASCII/SVG snapshot via scripts/snapshot.js that dumps page 100 as SVG into docs/), features, keyboard reference, run locally (npm run build && npm start, or open dist via node scripts/serve.js), tests, data sources, deploy to GitHub Pages instructions (Settings > Pages > GitHub Actions), hackathon category Resurrection, licence. docs/HOW_KIRO_WAS_USED.md: spec-driven development, steering, hooks, property tests, vibe vs spec, with concrete examples from this repo and honest about limits. docs/DEVPOST.md: draft project description (inspiration, what it does, how built, challenges, accomplishments, what's next), plus a 3-minute demo video script with timestamps and shot list.

Commit work in logical commits on the branch necrotext-build (use git add on specific paths; set a local git user if missing via repo-local config environment variables GIT_AUTHOR_NAME etc rather than modifying config).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds and produces dist/index.html with all assets
`npm test` passes including the property-based tests for 40x24 grid invariants across every registered page
`node scripts/serve.js` serves the app and `curl -s localhost:8080/` returns HTML containing the canvas/screen element, and data/*.json is served
Pages 100, 101, 400, 666, 667, 800, 888, 899 exist and render without throwing
.kiro/ contains specs (3 with requirements/design/tasks), steering (>=4 files), hooks (>=3) and is not in .gitignore
LICENSE is MIT; README has run instructions; docs/HOW_KIRO_WAS_USED.md and docs/DEVPOST.md exist
No em dashes in any written text or generated page content
git working tree is clean on branch necrotext-build with all work committed
verification: node scripts/serve.js & sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:8080/; kill %1
findings: Built and verified: npm run build, npm test (59 pass), npm run lint, npm run check-grid (82 pages), static server returns index/data/modules on PORT=8091. Run: npm start (build + serve on 8080; if 8080 is busy use PORT=8081 npm run serve). Sandbox had something already listening on 8080, so serving was verified on 8091. Unfinished/unverified: no headless browser, so canvas UI and CRT CSS were checked only with a recording fake canvas and SVG snapshots (docs/screens). fetch-data.js tested with fake fetch only; bundled data/ is hand-authored sample (fallback:true). Hooks not triggered in Kiro IDE. Finance page skipped. Note: a heredoc-heavy bash command was blocked once by the sandbox wrapper; files were rewritten with fs_write.
